cause: Refresh client omitted the Idempotency-Key required by API; 400 propagated into auth/me and systems error states.
method: Real axios running the actual boot module in Node VM with isolated in-memory storage, deliberately invalid access token and valid refresh token from a new login. Uses published API; not a browser expiration test.
regression: Two new tests fail against the previous boot source and pass after correction. Concurrent queries share one keyed refresh; original operation keys survive; 401 loops are bounded; 503 preserves credentials for another attempt.

browser.EricAdminCustomers: specific permission denial, as expected for Cliente
browser.limitation: Refresh branch was exercised against actual API with the real transport module; browser natural token expiry was not certified.
